name: Holling Adaptive Cycle Resilience Model
description: C.S. Holling's (1973, 2001) adaptive cycle model showing how ecosystems cycle through exploitation (r), conservation (K), release (Ω), and reorganization (α) phases. Foundation of resilience thinking and panarchy theory in social-ecological systems.

flows.name: Potential Change
flows.equation: IF Phase = 1 THEN Growth_Rate * Potential * (1 - Potential / K) ELSE IF Phase = 3 THEN -Release_Rate * Potential ELSE Reorganization_Rate * (K - Potential)

flows.name: Connectedness Change
flows.equation: IF Phase = 2 THEN Connection_Rate * (1 - Connectedness) ELSE IF Phase = 3 THEN -Disconnection_Rate * Connectedness ELSE 0

flows.name: Resilience Change
flows.equation: IF Phase = 4 THEN Recovery_Rate * (1 - Resilience) ELSE IF Phase = 2 THEN -Rigidity_Rate * Resilience ELSE 0

variables.name: Phase
variables.equation: IF Resilience < 0.2 THEN 3 ELSE IF Connectedness > 0.7 THEN 2 ELSE IF Potential < 20 THEN 4 ELSE 1

reference: Holling CS. Resilience and Stability of Ecological Systems. Annual Review of Ecology and Systematics. 1973;4:1-23.
